items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: when we had room for him, we took him on and carried him around with us for a while

ctx.x: Let's run him and Louis out there. Run him out.

We were talking about these towns going through like that. Now Punch, when he came into the Orleans, he played around with us. But they didn't recognize him so much because he hadn't been in the Orleans too long. And so he kind of palled around with us because we always accepted any performers, musicians, you know, and fix meals so they could have. And so he got to like us and when we had room for him, we took him on and carried him around with us for a while. He traveled with you then too?

Yes, he did. Because this record that you made, I think on the record label, it says recorded in New Orleans. So I thought maybe he didn't go out of the city with you. Oh, yes. He traveled with us. He went everywhere.
